about: Paras Healthcare Limited is a clinical specialty-led hospital chain providing tertiary and quaternary healthcare services under the 'Paras Health' brand. As of June 30, 2026, the company operated eight hospitals with an aggregate capacity of 2,211 beds across North India, Bihar, and Jharkhand. Its operations span five states and one union territory with a focused expansion pipeline to reach 3,011 beds by March 2028.

peers.name: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited
Yatharth Hospital and Trauma Care Services Limited

objects.purpose: Prepayment or scheduled repayment, in full or part, of certain outstanding borrowings availed by our Company
Investment in wholly owned Subsidiary, PMHPL, for repayment/prepayment of borrowings

promoters.background: Dr. Dharminder Kumar Nagar has over 22 years of healthcare experience, serves as co-chair of the FICCI Health Services Committee, and has led the commissioning of all company hospitals over the past 20 years.

concentration.note: Government Schemes and PSUs accounted for 41.28% of payor revenue in FY26, while Self-Pay accounted for 33.88% and Insurance/TPA accounted for 24.84%.

litigation_note: Contingent liabilities totaled ₹398.44 crore as of June 30, 2026, comprising 89.55% of net worth, primarily consisting of corporate guarantees of ₹376.40 crore, tax disputes of ₹5.82 crore, and medical negligence claims of ₹5.98 crore.
strengths: One of the largest healthcare platforms in North India, Bihar, and Jharkhand with 2,211 beds across eight hospitals.
First-mover advantages in key regional cities such as Gurugram, Panchkula, and Patna under the recognized 'Paras Health' brand.
Specialty depth with core CONGOR medical specialties contributing 74.70% of Fiscal 2026 operating revenue.
Capital-efficient operating model maintaining a low capital expenditure per bed of ₹0.77 crore.
Extensive medical talent pool consisting of 1,084 doctors and 1,937 nurses supported by high-end diagnostic infrastructure.
Cloud-first integrated technology ecosystem combining HIS, ERP, electronic health records, and digital patient engagement tools.
Experienced doctor-led senior management team with a proven 20-year execution record in hospital commissioning and scaling.

risks.title: History of Consolidated Net Losses
risks.detail: The company incurred net losses of ₹57.98 crore in FY25 and ₹15.33 crore in FY24, and cannot guarantee sustained future profitability.

risks.title: Subsidiaries Incurring Continued Operating Losses
risks.detail: Subsidiaries PHRPL and PMHPL collectively incurred losses of ₹52.09 crore in FY26 and ₹82.24 crore in FY25, creating operational drags.

risks.title: High Total Contingent Liabilities Relative to Net Worth
risks.detail: Contingent liabilities stood at ₹398.44 crore as of June 30, 2026, representing 89.55% of the company's net worth.

risks.title: Substantial Indebtedness and Repayment Obligations
risks.detail: Total outstanding borrowings amounted to ₹939.47 crore as of August 31, 2026, creating high finance costs and liquidity exposure.

risks.title: High Employee and Healthcare Staff Attrition Rates
risks.detail: The company experienced significant staff attrition of 60.38% in FY26 and 66.74% in FY25, affecting operational stability.

risks.title: Geographical Revenue Concentration in North India
risks.detail: Five hospitals located in North India contributed 66.07% of consolidated revenue from operations in Fiscal 2026.

risks.title: High Specialty Concentration in CONGOR Clinical Segments
risks.detail: Six key CONGOR specialty areas accounted for 74.70% of consolidated revenue from operations in Fiscal 2026.

risks.title: Operational Risks Associated with Leased Hospital Properties
risks.detail: Six of eight hospitals operate under leases or revenue-share arrangements, posing renewal, rent escalation, and landlord dispute risks.

notes: Figures are consolidated and restated. Values reported in INR million have been converted to ₹ crore. Stub periods for three months ended June 30, 2025 and June 30, 2026 are excluded from the annual financial series.
